services.desc: The National Comedy Center offers unprecedented opportunities for students of all ages to encounter comedy’s great minds and unique voices in ways that engage, inspire, and educate. As they explore 37,000 square feet of interactive and open-plan creative space, students will be immersed in multisensory, hands-on, and personalized learning environments developed by the Center’s award-winning curatorial and design team. The galleries take students on an interactive journey through comedy history, from early vaudeville to the latest viral memes, and are designed to promote individual discovery, spark curiosity, and celebrate self-expression.
